posts.subject: Calladmin
posts.bodyHtml: How about disabling the bit where when you !calladmin, it posts that message to the entire chat? Could be helpful where there are people who wont voteban so you call admin then the player (e.g a bhop scripter) then leaves and does not get punished.

The suggestion seems nice at first glance but it has a big disadvantage for admins. When other players can't see the calladmin messages in the chat, they don't know wether an admin was called or not, so they might use calladmin themselves resulting in multiple calls for admins about the same issue.


If you encounter a bhop scripter, please record a short demo and contact any admin on our TeamSpeak³ or post the demo on the forum.
In case that you don't know how to record a demo, read this short guide:
--> Wie erstelle ich eine Demo? / How do I record a demo? <---
